description:
Connect your TimelinesAI WhatsApp inbox to ChatGPT. List chats, read history, send messages, react, label, assign teammates — all as you, in production.

TimelinesAI is a multi-number WhatsApp inbox for teams. This app turns ChatGPT into a remote control for that inbox: browse chats with filters, read context windows around any message, send messages and threaded replies, react with emojis, manage labels, and assign chats to teammates. Every action runs under your TimelinesAI permissions and consumes the same quota as the UI. No sandbox — recipients see real messages from your number. Write actions require your confirmation in ChatGPT before they run.

defaultPrompt: Summarize my unread emails from this morning and draft a reply to the most important one.
Help me set up the WhatsApp Business API for my new company number and configure webhooks.
